memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savor: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour." (Ecclesiastes 10:1)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Traveling in a leaking boat is an extremely dangerous adventure. Before embarking on that hazardous journey, that leak must be completely repaired. If so, why shouldn't we fix the boat before setting out on that perilous trip? Otherwise, we can never safely reach our destination from where we started. We must not undertake the journey with complacency, thinking, "They are just small leaks, what big harm could this cause?"
​Therefore, we must never allow any kind of leaks to occur in our spiritual and secular lives. Various character flaws found within us are dangerous leaks in the boat of our life. Laziness, gluttony, anger, greed, and many more fleshly natures must never ruin and destroy our lives. Even a little folly can turn someone of great honor into someone of little value in society. As the scripture says, like a gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion what a great disgrace that is. Instead, divine wisdom will strengthen us to handle circumstances, and God's grace will continue to protect us. Our spiritual journey toward heaven in this boat will surely reach the shore safely and by grace, without any damage.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Small leaks sink great ships; a small spark burns down a great forest." — Proverb

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Our loving Father, protect us by Your gracious mercy so that leaks do not form in our boat of life due to ignorance, laziness, and anger. Fill our hearts with divine wisdom, mend us each day, and safely guide us toward Your eternal kingdom as our destination. In Jesus' name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Identify the small leaks in your life today and repair them with wisdom; your eternal journey will reach its destination by grace.
